ar.title: أرز لبّة باللحمة

steps.n2: حمّر البصل حتى يصبح ذهبياً، ثم أضف اللحم وقلّبه على نار عالية حتى تتشرب عصارته.
steps.n3: تبّله، وأضف ماءً يغمره، واتركه على نار هادئة 15–20 دقيقة.
steps.n4: أكمل الماء إلى 4–5 أكواب، وأضف الأرز، وتذوق التتبيل.
steps.n5: غطِّه واتركه يُطهى ببطء حوالي 30 دقيقة. يجب أن يصبح طرياً مثل العصيدة.
steps.n6: بالقوانص (الوصفة 314 في الكتاب): قلّب 5–6 حبات مستكة في زيت ساخن 10–15 ثانية، وأضف قوانص مسلوقة مقسومة نصفين، وغطِّها وأطفئ النار دقيقة أو دقيقتين، ثم حمّرها وأضف 4 أكواب ماء والأرز واطهها بنفس الطريقة.

en.title: Soft Rice Porridge with Beef (Ruzz Lubba bi-l-Lahma)
en.intro: Recipe 313, page 139 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

steps.n1: Cut the beef into bite-sized cubes.
steps.n2: Fry the onions until golden, add the beef and fry over a high heat until its juices are absorbed.
steps.n3: Season, add water to cover and cook over a low heat for 15–20 minutes.
steps.n4: Top up the water to 4–5 cups, stir in the rice and check the seasoning.
steps.n5: Cover and cook slowly for about 30 minutes. It should end up soft and porridge-like.
steps.n6: With gizzards (recipe 314 in the book): stir 5–6 mastic grains into hot oil for 10–15 seconds, add halved boiled gizzards, cover and turn off the heat for 1–2 minutes, then fry them, add 4 cups of water and the rice and cook the same way.

legacySteps: Cut the beef into bite-sized cubes.
Fry the onions until golden, add the beef and fry over a high heat until its juices are absorbed.
Season, add water to cover and cook over a low heat for 15–20 minutes.
Top up the water to 4–5 cups, stir in the rice and check the seasoning.
Cover and cook slowly for about 30 minutes. It should end up soft and porridge-like.

With gizzards (recipe 314 in the book): stir 5–6 mastic grains into hot oil for 10–15 seconds, add halved boiled gizzards, cover and turn off the heat for 1–2 minutes, then fry them, add 4 cups of water and the rice and cook the same way.
